modules.module_title: Maintain self-hygiene and cleanliness in the Kitchen

pcs.pc_description: maintain personal hygiene
wash hands before and after handling foods items to avoid cross contamination
use personal protective equipment like head cap, face mask and gloves while handling food items
maintain cleanliness of the surrounding, equipment, tools, and utensils while handling food

check for any adulterants in food items and escalate to the concerned authorities as per organizational policies

modules.module_title: Label, Store and Preserve raw materials

follow safe storage practices for raw food material as per recommended guidelines
follow inventory management processes such as FIFO to prevent spoilage
preserve food items using appropriate preservatives as per instructions
monitor stored items regularly
